name: Husqvarna TE 449 / TE 511
engine: 449 or 477 cc liquid-cooled single, fuel injected
intro: The BMW-era Husqvarna enduros with the countershaft next to the swingarm pivot.

H: Four-stroke motocross engines need frequent valve checks and oil changes. Follow the hour-based schedule in the manual, not the calendar.

recallNote: Off-road models are not always in the NHTSA recall search. Ask a Husqvarna dealer to run the VIN as well.
